Dialogs.Dialog: Are you not in a good mood today？
Hey, you're not feeling sick, are you？
Are you going to stay like this all day？
Is it going to be like this all day...？ Just kidding.
Hey... Why are you being so quiet？
Did talking get to be too much of a hassle...？
Such a quiet day today... Just kidding.
Hey... Can't you tell from the "hey"？
I kind of want to be spoiled... Sort of.
And here I am waiting... Just kidding. Hehe！
This is fun, isn't it？ Hehe！
I kind of feel like holding hands... Just kidding.
Would you mind if we held hands...？
My hand seems to be saying it's lonely.
Hehe, I also wanted to do this.
Sorry. I don't feel like it now.
Sorry, I can't... not right now.
We must look like lovers now, right？
Yeah, I thought so. I see... Hehe！
Hey... Is this kind of thing embarrassing after all？
Me too... But I'm happy. Hehe！
Ah, you're being shy. So cute. Hehe！
Yes. I... like warm hands... Sort of.
Guys really do have strong hands.
Not at all... I mean I... like it.
No... It's kind of cute. Hehe.
You know, when we're like this, I...
Yes... I'm so happy it's embarrassing.
Yeah, so big... Hey, can you hold my hand tighter？
I really like holding hands with you.
Hehe, so I won't let go. Okay？
Even though we're just holding hands, I...
You'd hate it if your friends saw us like this, right？
You're playing dumb. ...But I just can't help it. Sorry？
It's like I can feel what you're thinking when we do this.
Yes. So if you think anything naughty, I'll know. Hehe, just kidding.
Would you rather I let go, actually？
Because if you're only doing it for my sake...
No, never mind... I'm not letting go.
Is it unladylike for a girl to take a guy's hand first？
That's a relief... Because I don't think I can hold back.
I'm glad... that you held my hand.
I was in the mood too.
Yeah. Though I'd have grabbed it even if you didn't want me to... Just kidding.
Somehow I'm the only one whose heart's pounding... No fair.
Not at all. I feel the same way.
Thank you... If you say that, I'm never letting go.
Geez... Then I'll squeeze even tighter.
We got here before we knew it. Hehe.
Hey, do you not like holding hands with me？
Sorry about earlier... It was unladylike after all, wasn't it？
If you're just shy, that's fine, but if you... No, never mind.
Huh... Must be a lot of work to keep up.
But if you love it, you'd probably enjoy taking care of it, don't you think？
Especially if you lived with someone you love. I hope I can be like that...
You're right. It's like a house from a fairy tale.
Yeah. I want to live in a house like that someday...
...Geez, that face. You know the answer. Meanie.
I'd love to live in a condo like that.
Oh, the castle-looking one？ Getting in there was super competitive, and the price...
The inside must be lovely too... Wouldn't it be lovely to live there with someone you love？
Hehe. I'll be cheering for you▼
How big are the rooms in an apartment like that, I wonder？
Around 80 square feet at best？ An old place like that might be even smaller.
Does anyone live in that house？ It looks a little spooky, doesn't it？
...Hey, did you know？ There's actually a terrifying story about that house...
...Geez, why do you want me scared so badly？
Hehe！ Fine, I'll get scared just this once. Be sure to protect me, okay？
Look, birds on that twig. A pair, maybe？
Maybe. They're snuggled up, awfully close.
Maybe I'll copy them？ Can I snuggle up close？
Whoa, that's a lot of crows. ...Are they all looking at us？
Their little eyes are cute, so I don't mind them looking... but I'd rather not walk under them.
It could be dangerous. Let's take a detour.
Agreed. That way I get to be with you a little longer, too. I'll have to thank the crows.
Look at that kitty. It's sleeping so comfortably.
On top of the wall, too. Pretty skillful.
Do you toss and turn in your sleep, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Geez, don't ask a girl that？
That dog the couple over there is taking for a walk is so cute！
Oh, a black Shiba. Love those little dot eyebrows.
Yeah. Wouldn't it be lovely if someday we could take walks like that？
Hey, did you see that？ Someone was walking a sheep.
Yes. It was wearing clothes, so it must be a pet, right？
Clothes on a sheep... They better not be wool.
If they are, the poor thing. They'd come from its friends...
Yeah, it's a little windy today.
People compare them to feelings, but thinking that way, it's a little sad, huh？
But that's got nothing to do with us...
...Hehe, yeah. Right？ Oh, look, that cloud looks like a donut！
At this hour？ I think it might be a satellite rather than a shooting star.
Geez, you're no fun... The stars won't grant wishes for people who talk like that？
That'd be a problem. I want to wish that ▲高嶺＊＊▲ and I have fun together forever.
Then don't worry, I already wished for that▼ Hehe！
Huh, I didn't notice. What was it like？
It smelled really nice... Nothing like I've smelled before. What was it, I wonder？
Right？ Maybe we'll know if we pass by again. Let's save it for next time？
Ah, look！ The sky over there is so dark.
You're right. Maybe it'll rain. We should hurry.
Oh, then we're safe. That's ▲高嶺＊＊▲ for you.
Hehe. Sharing an umbrella is nice once in a while, isn't it？
Ah, something's in my eye... It hurts... Could you look？
This is... kind of making my heart race.
A-Anyway, there's no dust in there, so you're fine！
Ah, they're probably in junior high.
Maybe？ They're holding hands. How nice...
Geez, what are we both saying？ Hehe.
Hehe, what a cute couple. ...Would it be rude to say that？
The old man and woman are both smiling. They look great together.
Growing old like that must be such a happy thing.
Yeah. Should we make that our goal？
Hehe, agreed. I hope we get closer to it bit by bit, okay？
Oh. Just now, someone who looked just like you...
He's gone. He was wearing a suit, so maybe he works somewhere. ...Hehe.
He looked so cool. Now I have something to look forward to▼
Grade school, maybe？ That girl's so full of energy, isn't she？
She runs so much and never gets out of breath.
...I'm a little jealous. I wish I'd enjoyed being a kid more.
Then enjoy now that much more and you're set！ Right？
That bike that just passed... That's not allowed, is it？
Yeah, riding double is a no-no.
It's dangerous, right？ But I kind of dream of it... Snuggling up against your back like that.
Hehe. But riding double is a no-no, so I'll do it when we're not on a bike. Snuggle▼
Would you like to ride a big motorbike like the one that just passed？
Ah, the one with the sidecar？ I don't know...
Riding on the back scares me, but I think I'd enjoy one of those.
All right. If I ever become a biker, I'll buy that type.
Hehe！ I'll look forward to it？
I wonder if it's difficult to get a driver's license.
Hmm... Do you want one？ I figured you'd be forbidden since it's dangerous.
If I'm going to be a doctor, I'll need one, so that's fine. Our clinic does house calls.
I see... You've really thought it through.
But if I said I wanted to go driving with you, they might forbid it. Keep it a secret, okay？
I thought so, but I guess not. Hehe, you don't have to panic so much.
How could I not？ He might think I stole his cute daughter, right？
Yes, that deduction might be right on. Good luck when you face him, okay？
Hey, you need to be very careful. Don't get sick or hurt yourself, okay？ I don't know what I'd do if I didn't have you...
You be careful too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. If I ever lost ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I'd be sad too.
Y-Yeah. Just now, something like an alien went floating by... Didn't you see it？
I didn't... Weren't you imagining it？ A balloon or something.
...Right, I guess？ It moved way stranger than that... but I'll decide that's what it was. Yeah.
Where!? Don't tell me a lion escaped from the zoo!?
But nobody's making a fuss. Oh, it's a prank. Nice one, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Y-Yes！ It's a prank！ Total success...
(That reaction... Was she serious？ No way, right？)
！ Did you see that？ A big tortoise, walking really fast！
Yeah, a giant tortoise, maybe. It looked just like a real one. It surprised me.
A remote-control toy？ Even so, that's unusual...
Hehe. Its eyes were so cute▼ I wish you'd seen it too.
Wow... Hey, I don't know much about cars... but can they make the outside look like a bug？
Just now a car zoomed by that looked like a shiny brown bug with two antennae sticking out of its head.
I really don't think that's a thing...
Right？ But if it wasn't a car, what was it...？
...I think I mistook someone for him. Sorry for leaving you alone.
Don't be so down. Next time I'll chase him with you.
That was close... What the heck was that？
Thank you... Where did that fall from...？
(Next time we walk here, I'll be careful.)
